name: Duettist
summary: Whether singing a delicate duo with a nightingale or slipping coins from purses while a trained monkey distracts the crowd, the duettist blends his bond to his familiar with his natural talent for performance to create amazing effects.
replacesText: Well-Versed; Jack-of-all-Trades; Bardic Knowledge; Versatile Performance; Lore Master; Dirge of Doom; Frightening Tune

features.name: Diminished Competency
features.summary: A duettist does not gain the well-versed or jack-of-all-trades class features.

features.name: Familiar (Ex)
features.summary: At 1st level, a duettist gains a familiar , treating his bard level as his effective wizard level for the purpose of this ability. This ability replaces bardic knowledge.

features.name: Versatile Familiar (Ex)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a duettist’s familiar learns to use performance to supplement its skills. A duettist’s familiar benefits from its master’s versatile performance class feature. This ability alters versatile performance.

resourceActions.label: Apply Versatile Performance to familiar

activeEffect.name: Versatile Familiar
activeEffect.description: The familiar uses its master's selected Versatile Performance substitutions.

resourceActions.summary: Track the familiar's access to every selected Versatile Performance.

features.name: Performing Familiar (Su)
features.summary: At 4th level, a duettist’s familiar learns how to create supernatural effects with its performances, just like its master. The familiar can use any of its master’s bardic performances, but only the familiar or the duettist can have a performance active at any given time, not both. If one is performing and the other starts a performance, the previous performance immediately ends. Each round that the familiar performs consumes 2 rounds of the duettist’s bardic performance. This ability replaces lore master.

performanceRules.name: Performing Familiar
performanceRules.summary: The familiar performs one of the master's performances alone for 2 rounds of resource per round.

confirmations.label: The Duettist is not simultaneously performing

activeEffect.name: Performing Familiar
activeEffect.description: The familiar performs the selected Bardic Performance; starting another performance ends this one.

features.name: Harmonizing Familiar (Su)
features.summary: At 8th level, the duettist and his familiar have learned how to perform together in harmony. When a duettist and his familiar perform the same bardic performance simultaneously, its effects are enhanced. If the performance has a DC, the DC increases by 2. If the performance provides a competence bonus, the competence bonus increases by 1. Because both the duettist and the familiar are performing, each round performed consumes 3 rounds of bardic performance. This ability replaces dirge of doom.

performanceRules.name: Harmonizing Familiar
performanceRules.summary: Master and familiar perform the same performance: +2 DC or +1 competence bonus, for 3 rounds per round.

resourceActions.label: Harmonize one performance

modes.label: +2 save DC
modes.summary: Increase the performance's save DC by 2.

activeEffects.label: Harmonizing Familiar DC
activeEffects.description: +2 to the harmonized performance's save DC.

modes.label: +1 competence bonus
modes.summary: Increase the performance's competence bonus by 1.

activeEffects.label: Harmonizing Familiar competence
activeEffects.description: +1 to the competence bonus supplied by the harmonized performance.

confirmations.label: Master and familiar perform the same performance

resourceActions.summary: Spend 3 performance rounds per round and apply the appropriate enhancement.

features.name: Symphonic Familiar (Su)
features.summary: At 14th level, the duettist and his familiar have learned how to create a symphony of complementary performances that meld together to produce two different effects. They can each perform a different bardic performance simultaneously, and each has its full effect. Because both the duettist and the familiar are performing, each round performed consumes 3 rounds of bardic performance. This ability replaces frightening tune.

performanceRules.name: Symphonic Familiar
performanceRules.summary: Master and familiar maintain two different performances simultaneously for 3 rounds per round.

resourceActions.label: Begin two-performance symphony

confirmations.label: Master and familiar selected different Bardic Performances

activeEffect.name: Symphonic Familiar
activeEffect.description: Both different Bardic Performances remain active at full effect.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 3 performance rounds per round to sustain both effects.

mechanicalNotes: Familiar grant/progression, Versatile Performance sharing, familiar-only performance, harmonized enhancement, and simultaneous different performances are automated.
